rules.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('XSS')
rules.message: Unescaped HTML assignment ('dangerouslySetInnerHTML' / '.innerHTML' / 'mark_safe').
rules.compliant_snippet: el.textContent = userText; // or sanitize with DOMPurify

rules.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.message: HTTP client called with dynamically interpolated URL string.
rules.compliant_snippet: Validate hostname against an explicit allowlist before requesting.

rules.title: Improper Certificate Validation
rules.message: TLS certificate verification disabled ('verify=False' / 'rejectUnauthorized: false').

rules.title: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature ('Unverified JWT')
rules.message: JWT decoded with signature verification disabled.

rules.title: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference ('XXE')
rules.message: XML parser configured with 'resolve_entities=True'.

rules.title: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.message: Direct redirect to unvalidated request parameter or query string.

rules.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic ('NoSQL Injection')
rules.message: MongoDB '$where' operator executes arbitrary JavaScript on query evaluation.

rules.title: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.message: Direct mutation of '__proto__' or 'constructor.prototype'.

rules.title: Server-Side Template Injection ('SSTI')
rules.message: Dynamic template rendering via 'render_template_string' or 'jinja2.Template'.

rules.title: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
rules.message: Non-cryptographic PRNG ('random.*' / 'Math.random') used for secret/token/OTP.

rules.title: Insecure Temporary File
rules.message: 'tempfile.mktemp' is vulnerable to symlink race conditions (TOCTOU).

rules.title: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
rules.message: Hardcoded PEM private key block detected in source code.

rules.title: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains ('Insecure CORS')
rules.message: Wildcard 'allow_origins=["*"]' combined with 'allow_credentials=True'.

rules.title: Active Debug Code in Production
rules.message: Web application launched with 'debug=True'.

rules.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials (Leaked Cloud/API Token)
rules.message: Hardcoded AWS, GitHub, Stripe, or Slack secret token literal detected.

rules.title: Arbitrary File Overwrite via Archive Extraction ('ZipSlip')
rules.message: 'tarfile.extractall()' without 'filter="data"' allows path traversal.

rules.title: Unsafe PyTorch Model Deserialization
rules.message: 'torch.load()' without 'weights_only=True' uses pickle and can execute code.

rules.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Protection Disabled
rules.message: Disabling CSRF verification via '@csrf_exempt' exposes state-changing endpoints.
rules.compliant_snippet: # Keep CSRF middleware active for cookie-authenticated endpoints

rules.title: Dynamic Code Evaluation via 'new Function()'
rules.message: Constructing functions from strings via 'new Function()' is equivalent to eval().
rules.compliant_snippet: // Use a safe expression parser or predefined callback map

rules.title: Cross-Origin 'postMessage' with Wildcard TargetOrigin ('*')
rules.message: Sending messages with targetOrigin '*' leaks data to any embedding origin.

rules.title: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.message: Setting 'httpOnly: false' allows client-side scripts (XSS) to steal cookies.
rules.compliant_snippet: res.cookie('session', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true })

rules.title: Server Secret Exposed to Client Bundle via 'NEXT_PUBLIC_'
rules.message: Referencing 'NEXT_PUBLIC_*_SECRET' or 'NEXT_PUBLIC_*_PRIVATE_KEY' bundles secrets to browsers.

rules.title: Go TLS 'InsecureSkipVerify: true' Disables Certificate Validation
rules.message: Setting 'InsecureSkipVerify: true' exposes TLS connections to MITM attacks.

rules.title: Go 'http.ListenAndServe' Without Timeouts ('Slowloris DoS')
rules.message: Default 'http.ListenAndServe' has no ReadHeaderTimeout, enabling Slowloris DoS.

rules.title: Rust TLS 'danger_accept_invalid_certs(true)' Enabled
rules.message: Accepting invalid TLS certificates disables authenticity checks.

rules.title: Unsafe Type Reinterpretation via 'std::mem::transmute'
rules.message: 'mem::transmute' bypasses Rust's type system and can cause undefined behavior.
rules.compliant_snippet: // Use TryFrom / From or safe byte conversion methods (to_le_bytes)
